title: Tessera per-agent evaluation set
description: A curated subset of the failure catalogue bound to an agent package. Curated in AGIR · Curation; the registry's `eval_set` slug resolves to this manifest. The gate carries NO threshold (ADR 0021): the release bar is the same for every set and is measured, not chosen — the critical floor (zero tolerance) plus the model's contribution over the set's own null floor. A manifest declares only WHY, never a number.

slug.description: Stable identifier; must equal the file stem and match an agent's `eval_set`.

agent_id.description: The agent this set is bound to. Omitted for the shared/global catalogue set.

case_ids.description: Failure-catalogue case ids (file stems under eval/failures/). Every id must exist.

rationale.description: WHY this set's release bar is what it is. No threshold may be declared here: `additionalProperties: false` is what makes the removal of `min_pass_rate` (ADR 0021) irreversible by accident — reintroducing any bar fails schema validation in CI.
